objective: Make existing Cluster invitation links tappable in BUKLOD Connect as well as new Share/Copy/QR invitations tappable in ordinary messaging apps, preserving membership permissions and old links
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main SHA f773f44a0a5664f8c795b910f30bb31d848420f7 verified 2026-10-31 after offline Cluster/Faith merge #453; screenshot confirms inert old buklod:// link and source ConnectMessageBubble plain Text. No new Android APK, production OTA, or web route smoke test claimed.
chosenApproach: Reuse the existing central Cluster invite helper but emit public HTTPS links to the existing Expo Router /clusters/[id] destination; retain strict parsers for old buklod:// and staging schemes, test QR round-trip and hostile URL inputs. Do not change native intent filters in an OTA-only share fix. Also linkify explicit http(s) and legacy Cluster scheme segments inside the shared Connect message bubble with an internal authorized Cluster screen route and bounded URL opening errors.
alternativeApproaches: Keep buklod:// and assume messenger auto-detection (rejected: screenshot proves non-tappable text)
Add HTTPS App Links intent filter and digital asset association only (rejected as immediate fix: installed v28 has no HTTPS intent filter, and native binary/signing verification would be required)
Share a public HTTPS deep route and accept legacy schemes (selected: external apps linkify HTTPS and web fallback is usable without a new APK)
Only change the shared scheme to HTTPS (rejected as insufficient: already sent messages in BUKLOD Connect still render as plain, inert Text).
selectionRationale: A central builder is used by all three sharing surfaces, so one isolated change updates Share/Copy/QR without duplicating logic. The existing route protects cluster join approval and pending login intent. Nonproduction binaries preserve their existing schemes to prevent cross-environment routing. BUKLOD Connect currently renders entire bodyText as ordinary Text; a small reusable text segmenter and nested Text onPress fixes direct and scoped chat without changing message storage.
preserveBehaviors: Staging/classroom variants retain their configured nonproduction schemes; they must not route invitation recipients into the production main site
Previously shared buklod:// and buklod-staging:// QR/messages still parse
Existing route /clusters/[id], cluster join roles, approval checks, and backend unchanged
Authentication, session, pending invitation, and membership permission checks unchanged
Wall, Connect, media, Show Faith, Quiz, release workflow, native build settings untouched
Do not claim HTTPS auto-opens installed Android app until native App Links, signing certificate and association are verified
Message body text, replies, reactions, media, timestamps, long-press menu and background presentation remain unchanged
Cluster invite tap routes internally through existing /clusters/[id] permission-enforcing screen; web URLs open only on explicit tap
acceptanceChecks: Production BUKLOD Share, Copy and QR share https://buklod.expo.app/clusters/{uuid}?fromInvite=1; staging and classroom keep their nonproduction schemes
Parsing of old custom schemes and path links remains supported
Reject non-BUKLOD HTTPS origins, malformed segments and unexpected URL paths
Focused Node and Jest tests pass; no unrelated code changed
Website live route and installed app opening require independent verification
Before production OTA reconcile exact live runtime 1.3.2 and latest main/RC; publish no unverified change
Already-sent buklod:// invite in BUKLOD Connect is rendered as a tappable link in the exact original message text
Direct/scoped Connect bubble supports HTTPS and legacy link taps, retains punctuation, emoji, replies and long-press actions
Unsupported custom schemes and malformed Cluster IDs are not clickable; other http(s) URLs open only on explicit tap
